issues.problem: av-doumo example 5 opened with 話を聞くと, an awkward way to say 'from what I hear' before らしい.
issues.action: Changed to 聞いた話では、どうやら会議は中止になったらしい。

issues.problem: av-doumo mistake 'どうも夢のようだ' is not clearly wrong: it can be read as an inference ('it somehow seems to be a dream').
issues.action: Replaced with a sentence that can only be a simile: どうやら夢のように楽しい一日だった (bad) / まるで夢のように楽しい一日だった (good); note updated.

issues.problem: av-zehi contrast cited どうも寒い as a typical impression; it is a weak, slightly odd example.
issues.action: Changed to どうも調子が悪い.

issues.problem: av-moshi contrast example もし晴れたら、きっと楽しい ended abruptly; きっと normally closes with だろう / よ.
issues.action: Changed to もし晴れたら、きっと楽しいよ.

issues.problem: av-marude contrast with たとえ said both talk about something not real; たとえ's condition can be real.
issues.action: Reworded: たとえ's case may be real or imagined; まるで's comparison is never literally true.
